skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature and characteristics of commercial insurance
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Grasp the essence and features of commercial insurance, including life insurance, vehicle insurance, fire insurance, money insurance, and property insurance.

Understand and apply the operational mechanisms and principles of commercial insurance in various types such as life insurance, vehicle insurance, fire insurance, money insurance, and property insurance.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing and evaluating risks in commercial insurance
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge of commercial insurance principles to analyze and assess risks, monitor business processes, and manage various types of insurance operations.
Develop research abilities, independent work skills, logical and critical thinking, teamwork, presentation skills, and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrate personal accountability and responsibility towards team work.
